core_entities.name: DoorFL5LampFadeSpdCmd_1
core_entities.description: Controls the fade speed of the front left door lamp during breathing mode.

core_entities.name: DoorFL6LampOnOff_1
core_entities.description: Enables or disables the front left door lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorFL6LampColorCmd_1
core_entities.description: Sets the color of the front left door lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorFL6LampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Adjusts the brightness of the front left door lamp.

core_entities.name: DoorFL6LampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Controls the breathing (pulsing) effect of the front left door lamp.

core_conditions.name: 呼吸周期指令
core_conditions.description: Command to make the lamp blink periodically according to a specified breathing cycle.

core_conditions.name: 不同呼吸模式切换
core_conditions.description: Switching between different breathing modes stops the current mode and starts the next one.

core_conditions.name: 颜色/亮度切换时间
core_conditions.description: Time required to transition from the current state to the target state when changing color or brightness.

core_outputs.name: 灯头闪烁
core_outputs.description: The lamp head blinks according to the breathing cycle command.

core_outputs.name: 灯头颜色/亮度切换
core_outputs.description: The lamp changes color or brightness as commanded.

core_outputs.description: If the command value is 0 or undefined, the lamp maintains its current color.
